selection.chosen: stage-matched RKDG: (p+1)-stage explicit RK per degree; SSP-RK(5,4) at p=4; observed order compared with the reference column using one shared estimator

rejected.reason: stage count does not match the reference column; at p=4 the time integrator caps the observed order

rejected.option: 6-stage order-5 Butcher RK at p=4 (round 2 default)
rejected.reason: order matched but the stage count did not; the reference column has 5 stages

rejected.option: claim order = stages = p+1 at p=4
rejected.reason: impossible: explicit 5-stage methods cannot reach order 5 (Butcher barrier)
